usageNotes: Returns the ordered list of host-level firewall rules for a specific node (not VM/CT rules). Rules are returned in positional order; the `pos` field is the zero-based index used by rule-specific endpoints. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/nodes/{node}` — API tokens must have this privilege explicitly granted.

examples.summary: List all firewall rules on node pve01

tips: Each returned object's `pos` value is the handle for GET/PUT/DELETE on /nodes/{node}/firewall/rules/{pos}.
Rules with `enable: 0` are present in the list but inactive; check this field before assuming a rule is enforced.
An `action` that does not match ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT is a security group reference — it will not have src/dest/port fields of its own.
This endpoint covers only the node host firewall chain. VM and container rules live under /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/firewall/rules and /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/firewall/rules respectively.
The node firewall must be enabled at the node level (not just cluster level) for these rules to be active; verify with get_nodes_node_firewall_options.
